_note: Pure-AST fleet-wide guard, so it runs in the base environment: python3 bin/mutate.py --spec mutations/provider-contract.json --python $(command -v python3). Proves tests/test_provider_contract.py is not vacuous: it must fail when a real provider drifts off the extract_val_features contract. One real provider (14_simclrv1, the canonical pilot) is broken two distinct ways -- the extractor renamed, and a required parameter dropped -- and each must be caught by the fleet check. The guard names no method; this spec may, because it targets a concrete file (mutation specs are .json, exempt from the discover-never-list rule).
